title: FlowchartDiagram
description: The flowchart diagram body: its orientation, its root graph, and the nodes and relationships that make it up. This is the first of several diagram bodies; swimlane, gantt, and the rest follow as sibling schemas in this folder.
$comment: Deferred, to revisit: (4) inline per-node `style` string — held pending a simple representation; class binding via `classes` is the current path. (13) node interaction — `click` events (callback/href/tooltip/target) — not yet modeled.

relationships.description: The relationships (edges) between nodes in the flowchart.

classDefs.description: The flowchart's style classes. Declared at the top level because classDef is diagram-global, not subgraph-scoped: node and relationship ids share one global namespace, so a class binds by name from anywhere in the diagram.

linkStyles.description: Link styling by definition order (Mermaid `linkStyle`), distinct from class binding.

nodeShape.description: A Mermaid node shape, named by its descriptive geometry (v11.3.0+). These are readable names, not the literal `@{ shape: <name> }` tokens Mermaid accepts; a mapping to those short tokens is still needed before this is referenced by the main schema.

linkType.description: A Mermaid flowchart link (edge) kind, named by the connection it draws. These are readable names, not the literal Mermaid operators (`-->`, `---`, `-.->`, `==>`, `~~~`, `--o`, `--x`, `o--o`, `<-->`, `x--x`); a mapping to those operators is still needed before this is referenced by the main schema.

relationship.description: A relationship (edge) between flowchart nodes. Populated incrementally with the attributes that make up a relationship.

id.description: An optional edge ID (the `id@` prefix in Mermaid, e.g. `A e1@--> B`), usable later for styling, classes, and animation.

from.description: The id of the source node the relationship starts from.

to.description: The id of the target node the relationship points to.

classes.description: Names of classDefs applied to this relationship (bound by the edge id). Each entry must match a classDefs[].name.

label.description: Text attached to the link, rendered on the edge.

length.description: The number of ranks the link spans. 1 is the default; a higher value lengthens the link (the extra dashes in Mermaid). The renderer may still draw it longer to satisfy other links.

animate.description: Whether the edge is animated (requires the edge `id`).

animation.description: The animation speed; setting it implies animate:true.

node.description: A flowchart node. Populated incrementally with the attributes that make up a node.

id.description: The node's identifier, used to reference it from relationships.

text.description: The display text in the node box, differing from the id. Stored as a raw Unicode string; the renderer quotes it (Mermaid requires double quotes around Unicode text, e.g. id["This ❤ Unicode"]). When text is defined several times for a node, Mermaid uses the last definition.

markdown.description: Whether text is a Markdown string. When true the renderer encloses it in double quotes and backticks (e.g. id["`This **is** _Markdown_`"]), enabling bold/italics, automatic wrapping, and newline-based line breaks. Defaults to false (plain text).

classes.description: Names of classDefs applied to this node (Mermaid `class`/`:::`). Each entry must match a classDefs[].name.

classDef.description: A named style class (Mermaid `classDef name style`), bound to nodes and relationships by name through their `classes` field.

name.description: The class name referenced by a node or relationship `classes` entry. The reserved name `default` applies to every node without an explicit class.

style.description: The style declarations, comma-separated as Mermaid writes them, e.g. `fill:#f9f,stroke:#333,stroke-width:4px`.

orientation.description: The orientation of the graph. `TB` top to bottom; `TD` top-down (same as top to bottom); `BT` bottom to top; `RL` right to left; `LR` left to right.

icon.description: An icon node (Mermaid `@{ icon: ... }`). Requires a registered icon pack.
The icon name from the registered icon pack, e.g. `fa:user`.

form.description: The background shape behind the icon. Omitted means no background.

label.description: The text label for the icon. Omitted means no label.

pos.description: The label position, top or bottom. Defaults to bottom.

h.description: The icon height. Defaults to 48, which is the minimum.

img.description: The URL of the image to display.

label.description: The text label for the image. Omitted means no label.

pos.description: The label position, top or bottom. Defaults to bottom.

w.description: The image width. Defaults to the natural width.

h.description: The image height. Defaults to the natural height.

constraint.description: Whether the image constrains the node size and keeps its aspect ratio. Defaults to off.

curveStyle.description: The curve style for a link's line.

linkStyle.description: A link styling by definition order (Mermaid `linkStyle`), distinct from class binding.

indices.description: The zero-based order indices of the links this style applies to (the Nth link defined in the diagram).

default.description: Apply the style to all links (Mermaid `linkStyle default ...`) instead of specific indices.

style.description: The style declarations, comma-separated as Mermaid writes them, e.g. `stroke:#ff3,stroke-width:4px,color:red`.

graph.description: A flowchart graph: its nodes, the relationships between them, and nested subgraphs. Recursive — each subgraph is itself a graph.

id.description: An explicit subgraph id (Mermaid `subgraph id [Title]`), referenced by edges to and from the subgraph and required to collapse it.

view.description: Whether the subgraph is drawn in full (`expanded`, the default) or as a single compact node carrying its title (`collapsed`, Mermaid `@{ view: collapsed }`).

relationships.description: The relationships (edges) between nodes in this graph.

subgraphs.description: Nested subgraphs, each a graph in its own right.
